pass_gates.rule: For K<1, all shapes remain observationally safe; no broad local/folded/equilateral leakage.
Large normalized fNL, if present, remains localized near K~3.5--3.7.
Absolute bispectrum amplitude and perturbativity ratios remain finite and smooth.
No broad unsuppressed squeezed/local-type signal leaks to CMB scales.

fail_gates.rule: Any relevant operator or shape produces large unsuppressed non-Gaussianity for K<1.
Absolute bispectrum amplitude diverges or becomes nonconvergent.
Exit feature leaks broadly across K or shape space.
